title: Insights
subtitle: How the company changes over the year: people, tenure, turnover, time off and pay.

headcount.title: Number of employees
headcount.subtitle: People employed at the end of each month
headcount.label: Employed at the end of {{month}}
headcount.about: The base every other figure is built on — turnover, tenure and averages are all relative to it. Select a month to see who makes it up.

tenure.title: Average tenure
tenure.subtitle: Whole months worked by the people employed at the end of the year
tenure.label: Average tenure
tenure.about: How long people stay. Short tenure in one area points to a retention problem worth a closer look.

turnover.title: Staff turnover
turnover.subtitle: Hires and leavers by month
turnover.about: People who left in the year as a share of the average month-end headcount. Select a month to see who joined and who left.

absence.title: Absence
absence.subtitle: Top 10 by approved working days off this year
absence.label: Average days off per person
absence.empty: No approved time off this year.
absence.about: Who takes the most time off, by type. A rise in sick days can signal burnout or dissatisfaction early.

salary.title: Average salary
salary.subtitle: Monthly, from each person’s latest completed review
salary.label: Average monthly salary
salary.about: Pay across groups, to benchmark levels and spot gaps. Each person counts with their salary at the end of the year.
